facts.fact: 2019 年跨年夜，Kate 走到 Herne Hill 朋友家的花园里。
facts.anchor: Kate stepped out through the bifold doors, into the cool darkness of the garden.

facts.fact: Smith 对两项谋杀指控已表示不认罪。
facts.anchor: He’d already pleaded not guilty to two counts of murder.

facts.fact: Kate 仍在犹豫要不要去旁听审判。
facts.anchor: Kate remained in two minds about whether to attend court.

facts.fact: Smith 1998 至 2001 年在利兹读英语。
facts.anchor: He had not attended university in either Glasgow or Edinburgh, but studied English in Leeds from 1998 to 2001.

facts.fact: 大二时他住 Otley Road，与 Emily 合住底层公寓。
facts.anchor: In his second year, he lived on Otley Road, sharing a ground-floor flat with Emily Pierce.

facts.fact: Alice 与 Gareth 回到公寓时发现了 Emily 的尸体。
facts.anchor: Alice told Kate about finding Emily’s body when she returned to the flat with her friend (now partner) Gareth

facts.fact: Smith 用现金买火车票，却被伦敦与利兹车站的监控拍到。
facts.anchor: He had paid for the return train ticket in cash, so there was no bank transaction, but was caught on CCTV at London King’s Cross station and on the station concourse at Leeds

facts.fact: Kate 把并排的两颗星当作 Emily 与 Olivia。
facts.anchor: She told herself one was Emily, the other Olivia.

facts.fact: 她轻声对两颗星说晚安。
